messages:
tara: Cutting RC v3.5.1-rc1 for batching heuristics + runtime fixes. Artifact sha256=8f7c9a1b2c3d4e5f00112233445566778899aabb. Change window 2026-04-01 01:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: kv-warm (t-10m) -> canary 4% (10m) -> 30% (20m) -> full. Rollback: promote v3.5.0 + flip `batching_v2` off. Need ops/telemetry thumbs.
deploy-bot: rc created: rc-v3.5.1-rc1 (artifact 8f7c9a...). Promo window set 2026-04-01T01:00Z. Use `/deploy promote rc-v3.5.1-rc1 --pin=8f7c9a` to promote. KV warm dry-run passed in staging.
ben: LGTM. I'll cover autoscaler + pool health. If RSS > 85% for 3m during 30% scale, we abort.
oliver: I'll own SLOs and traces, watching p50/p95/p999. Also re-running smoke-evals on a sampled canary traffic.
sheriff: ack. I'll be primary oncall for the window and will monitor #telemetry and #incidents.
tara: starting kv-warm now (triggered). Will post updates at each milestone.
deploy-bot: KV warm complete: 100% keys warmed. No cold start regression in baseline.
deploy-bot: canary initiated: 4% traffic -> rc-v3.5.1-rc1
oliver: initial canary looks clean. p95 unchanged, error rate within noise.
ben: tiny CPU bump on one host at t+5m, autoscaler added capacity and normalized. Noted.
deploy-bot: scheduled escalation to 30% in 10m unless aborted.
tara: escalating to 30% now.
deploy-bot: canary escalation executed: 30% traffic -> rc-v3.5.1-rc1
oliver: 30% hold: traces clean, no SLO regressions. Proceeding with final checks.
ben: smoke tests and downstream ingestion checks OK. Pin previous artifact v3.5.0 as rollback: pin=ccbbaa9988.
tara: promoting to 100% now: `/deploy promote rc-v3.5.1-rc1 --pin=8f7c9a` (executing)
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Traffic at 100% for rc-v3.5.1-rc1. Rollback window open (30m). Old version v3.5.0 pinned for quick rollforward.
sheriff: rollback window active. Will escalate for any anomalies.
oliver: monitoring looks stable. Will close GA checklist after rollback window.
tara: thanks team  will post final release notes and changelog link after window expires.
